title: Prove exact main artifacts and consumer proof reach release promotion
text: The corrected commit-tag API is served. Candidate code promotes verified exact-main wheel bytes and native image digests, retires tag allocation and reuses exact product/consumer proof. Final consumer integration, production artifact equality and release-duration measurements remain unproven until activation delivery; no live speed improvement is claimed. Rollout also owes proof that existing relay bootstraps can install numeric release identities before activation.
